description: This source file 'cg_view.cpp' is part of the game client code for Unvanquished, responsible for setting up and rendering the 3D view, handling camera controls (including third-person and shoulder views), model testing, frustum culling, field of view calculations, and visual effects such as color grading and reverb effects. It includes functions for camera offsetting, view calculation, scene rendering, and debugging tools.

classes.name: TestShaderCmd
classes.description: A command class for testing shaders by drawing a polygon with a specified shader.

methods.name: CG_TestModel_f
methods.description: Creates a test model entity in front of the player for viewing or testing.

methods.name: CG_TestGun_f
methods.description: Replaces the current view weapon with a test model.

methods.name: CG_TestModelNextFrame_f
methods.description: Advances the test model to the next animation frame.

methods.name: CG_TestModelPrevFrame_f
methods.description: Reverts the test model to the previous animation frame.

methods.name: CG_TestModelNextSkin_f
methods.description: Switches the test model to the next skin.

methods.name: CG_TestModelPrevSkin_f
methods.description: Switches the test model to the previous skin.

methods.name: CG_AddTestModel
methods.description: Adds the test model entity to the scene, re-registering models and positioning them.

methods.name: CG_OffsetThirdPersonView
methods.description: Calculates and offsets the camera for third-person view, including handling dead player views and camera collision.

methods.name: CG_OffsetShoulderView
methods.description: Calculates and offsets the camera for shoulder view, including mouse input handling.

methods.name: CG_OffsetFirstPersonView
methods.description: Offsets the camera for first-person view, including bobbing, damage effects, and movement.

methods.name: CG_CalcFov
methods.description: Calculates the field of view, including zoom and underwater effects.

methods.name: CG_DrawSurfNormal
methods.description: Draws a visual indicator of the surface normal the player is looking at.

methods.name: CG_addSmoothOp
methods.description: Adds a smoothing operation for surface transitions.

methods.name: CG_smoothWWTransitions
methods.description: Smoothly transitions between different wall-walking surface normals.

methods.name: CG_smoothWJTransitions
methods.description: Smoothly transitions between different wall-jumping surface normals.

methods.name: CG_CalcColorGradingForPoint
methods.description: Sets color grading weights based on proximity to models.

methods.name: CG_ChooseCgradingEffectAndFade
methods.description: Selects color grading effects based on player state.

methods.name: CG_InstantCgradingEffectAndFade
methods.description: Determines instant color grading effects, such as zoom effects.

methods.name: CG_AddColorGradingEffects
methods.description: Handles smooth transitions and application of color grading effects.

methods.name: CG_AddReverbEffects
methods.description: Adds reverb effects based on location.

methods.name: CG_StartShadowCaster
methods.description: Creates a dynamic shadow caster light for shadows.

methods.name: CG_EndShadowCaster
methods.description: Ends the shadow caster setup.

methods.name: CG_CalcViewValues
methods.description: Calculates the camera view origin, angles, effects, and effects for the current frame.

methods.name: CG_SetupFrustum
methods.description: Sets up the view frustum planes for culling.

methods.name: CG_CullBox
methods.description: Performs frustum culling on a bounding box.

methods.name: CG_CullPointAndRadius
methods.description: Performs frustum culling on a point with radius.

methods.name: CG_DrawActiveFrame
methods.description: Main function to generate and draw the current game scene for a frame.
